Hi Jordan —

Quick background: Alejandro (ex-Senior Infra Engineer at Quantique Analytics) completed on-site loop last week. Team and interviewers are aligned on Level 5 leveling given system design breadth and infra ownership. He has a competing verbal counteroffer with a higher base than our usual L5 band. Candidate is asking for base +7% over the published band floor and a $15k sign-on (prorated RSU schedule requested).

Proposed package (what hiring team is requesting):
- Level: 5 (staff-equivalent scope)
- Base: $215,000 (our L5 midpoint is $200k; requested is +7%)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (split 50/50 sign-on/first-year retention payout)
- RSU: Standard L5 grant (negotiable cadence)

I attached an "alejandro_comp_sheet.pdf" and a brief comp comparison. This would require a band exception approval (band uplift) — asking for explicit sign-off from Lauren and Marissa; Finance (Stephanie) to confirm run-rate and comp bucket.

Candidate timeline: he asked for an answer before next Wednesday 23 Dec. He is enthusiastic about Redwood (esp. our serving runtime work) but wants clarity on the base and sign-on quickly.

Next steps we need from leadership:
- Lauren: level confirmation and sign-off for L5 band uplift
- Marissa: authorization for sign-on structure and any special RSU cadence
- Stephanie: Finance ok for incremental spend (headcount budget + one-time sign-on)

Appreciate quick replies — happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
